name: Tsubetsu (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tsubetsu town emblem in white: a stylised bird with angular wings above a broken ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tsubetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 1958.

features.role: Tsubetsu town emblem — a stylised bird with angular wings above a broken ring
